WITH qual_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.ID
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE l."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(l."U-PRO") <> ''
    AND l."U-PRO" <> '-'
),
per_patient AS (
  SELECT l.ID,
         AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt,
         AVG(CAST(l.ALP AS REAL) / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0)) AS avg_alp_gpt
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE l.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM qual_patients)
  GROUP BY l.ID
)
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.SEX), ''), '') AS sex,
       AVG(pp.avg_pt) AS avg_of_patient_avg_pt,
       AVG(pp.avg_alp_gpt) AS avg_of_patient_avg_alp_gpt_ratio
FROM per_patient pp
JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = pp.ID
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.SEX), ''), '')
